TASK: Rewrite TWO files to use React Polaris components instead of `<s-*>` web components:
1. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.widget.tsx`
2. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.analytics.tsx`

IMPORTANT: The app already has PolarisAppProvider set up in app.tsx. All React Polaris components are available.

MIGRATION RULES — Replace every `<s-*>` component:
- `<s-page heading="X">` → `<Page title="X" backAction={{ onAction: () => navigate("/app") }}>`
- `<s-section heading="X">` → use `<BlockStack gap="600">` or `<Layout.Section>` 
- `<s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">` → `<Card>`
- `<s-stack direction="block" gap="base">` → `<BlockStack gap="400">`
- `<s-stack direction="inline" gap="base">` → `<InlineStack gap="400">`
- `<s-stack direction="inline" gap="small-200">` → `<InlineStack gap="200">`
- `<s-heading>` → `<Text as="h2" variant="headingMd" fontWeight="bold">`
- `<s-text>` → `<Text as="p" variant="bodyMd">`
- `<s-text color="subdued">` → `<Text as="p" variant="bodyMd" tone="subdued">`
- `<s-text tone="neutral">` → `<Text as="p" variant="bodyMd" tone="subdued">`
- `<s-badge tone="X">Y</s-badge>` → `<Badge tone="X">Y</Badge>`
- `<s-button variant="primary" onClick={fn}>` → `<Button variant="primary" onClick={fn}>`
- `<s-button variant="tertiary">` → `<Button>` (default secondary)
- `<s-button href="/app/X">` → `<Button url="/app/X">`
- `<s-button loading={x}>` → `<Button loading={x}>`
- `<s-button slot="primary-action">` → Page `primaryAction` prop
- `<s-banner tone="X" heading="Y">` → `<Banner tone="X" title="Y">`
- `<s-divider />` → `<Divider />`
- `<s-switch checked={x} onChange={fn} />` → `<Checkbox checked={x} onChange={fn} />` or use a custom toggle
- `<s-link href="X">Y</s-link>` → `<Button variant="plain" url="X">Y</Button>`
- `<s-unordered-list>` + `<s-list-item>` → `<List>` + `<List.Item>`
- `<s-clickable onClick={fn}>` → `<div onClick={fn} style={{cursor:"pointer"}}>`
- `<s-text-field label="X" value={v} onChange={fn}>` → `<TextField label="X" value={v} onChange={fn} autoComplete="off" />`
- `<s-select>` + `<s-option>` → `<Select label="X" options={[{label,value}]} value={v} onChange={fn} />`
- `<s-number-field>` → `<TextField label="X" type="number" value={v} onChange={fn} autoComplete="off" />`
- `<s-button-group>` → `<ButtonGroup>` or `<ButtonGroup variant="segmented">`
- `<s-paragraph>` → `<Text as="p" variant="bodyMd">`

IMPORTANT for React Polaris event handlers:
- `<TextField onChange>` receives the value string directly: `onChange={(value) => setValue(value)}`
- `<Select onChange>` receives the value string directly: `onChange={(value) => setValue(value)}`  
- `<Checkbox onChange>` receives the new checked boolean: `onChange={(checked) => setChecked(checked)}`
- NO need for `(e: Event) => (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value` pattern — that was only for web components

For the Widget page's WidgetPreview component: KEEP all custom inline styles as-is (it's a visual mockup).
For the Widget page's ColorPickerField: keep the native `<input type="color">` with custom styling (no Polaris color picker).
For radio-selection cards (DisplayModeCard, PositionGrid, TriggerTypeSelector): use `<Card>` with `onClick` and visual selected state via a thicker `<Box borderWidth="050">` or just conditionally styled.

For Analytics bar chart: keep the custom div-based BarChart component (no Polaris chart component).

For responsive stat grids: `<InlineGrid columns={{ xs: 1, sm: 2, md: 4 }} gap="400">`

IMPORTS needed for each file:
```typescript
import { useNavigate } from "react-router";
import {
  Page, Layout, Card, BlockStack, InlineStack, Text, Badge, Button,
  ButtonGroup, Banner, Box, Divider, InlineGrid, TextField, Select,
  Checkbox, ProgressBar, List, Icon,
} from "@shopify/polaris";
```

KEEP: All loader/action logic, types, constants, helpers, WidgetPreview component (custom styles OK for preview mockup) unchanged. Only rewrite JSX rendering.

Read each file first, understand structure, then rewrite. Files should have ZERO `<s-` elements when done (except inside WidgetPreview which is a custom storefront mockup). Verify by searching.
